$comment: DSH logo override manifest. Point each artwork at a file in ./assets/ and run
brand-override/generated/artwork.js and every generated/artwork/<slot>/ shadow file.
Raster sources (.png/.jpg/.webp) are inlined as data URIs; .svg sources are copied
as-is so their gradients, filters and internal ids keep working.

sidebarName.label: Sidebar wordmark (text next to the mark)

$comment: Right-rail and ornament art. Optional entries (source: null) fall back to the built-in look:
expressions[].source  full transparent portrait shown when that expression is picked (falls back to mascot)
expressions[].thumb   square transparent head crop for the picker button (falls back to a zoomed portrait)
memo.source           transparent sticky-note PNG (falls back to the CSS paper note)
cornerStar.source     transparent four-point star used on panel corners (falls back to the inline SVG star)
